newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - FACTORS TO WATCH - AUG 8.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - FACTORS TO WATCH - AUG 8.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Friday:
* On Thursday, the Dow Jones industrial average skidded 71.31 points to close at 8,188 on renewed interest-rate worries.
* Indonesian Finance Minister Mar'ie Muhammad said on Thursday the current policy of tightening rupiah liquidity would be eased gradually.
* Mar'ie paid a surprise visit to the stock exchange on Thursday to bolster confidence as the market index suffered one of its sharpest one-day falls.
* On Thursday, the Jakarta composite index ended down 21.92 points, or 3.13 percent, at 677.94 points.
* On Friday, the rupiah was traded at 2,593.00/95.00 at 0205 GMT against an opening of 2,585.00/2,593.00.
* Banking and property stocks on worries over higher interest rates.
* Indosat on a Bisnis Indonesia report the firm was likely to buy a stake in loss-making privately-owned television station TPI.
* Small-sized property firm Bumi Modern on reports that privately-owned Bakrie Capital planned to buy a 58-percent stake in the firm.
* Bank Umum Nasional on announcement of a rise in first half net profit.

* Transportation firm Steady Safe and toll road operator Citra Marga after Steady Safe's shareholders approved a proposal to acquire up to a 19.9 percent stake in Citra Marga. --Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
